risks.title: International law risks (ITAR, FCPA)
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly mentioned in the 10-K as recurring, with possible investigations into international operations. Language indicates ongoing exposure to strict laws such as ITAR and FCPA. The Regulation category is heavily weighted in the defense sector. Central position in the report.

risks.title: Significant commercial commitments
risks.score_rationale: Total commitments of 1.795 billion dollars, primarily related to ISR and PSPC segments. The elevated and concentrated amount on performance guarantees. Risk of customer drawdown in case of default is explicit. Detailed position with key figures.

risks.title: Segment restructuring
risks.score_rationale: Transition from four to three segments announced as optimization. Nevertheless, any restructuring carries integration and operational disruption risks. Mention in footnotes but not in Risk Factors, so moderate intensity of language.

risks.title: Dependence on U.S. government
risks.score_rationale: 75% of revenue derives directly or indirectly from U.S. government customers. Exposure is significant to changes in budget priorities and defense policy. Variations in government appropriations directly impact demand.

risks.title: Uncertainty related to government budgets and funding continuity
risks.score_rationale: History of government shutdowns (43 days in October 2025), resolutions through Continuing Resolutions rather than annual appropriations, and uncertainty regarding future funding priorities. Direct impacts on government contracts.

ai_positioning.summary: LHX does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning as major strategic initiatives in its fiscal 2025 10-K/20-F report.
